summary: Premium on PayPal subscriptions with prorated upgrades and an owner billing panel, voice recordings, professional logging and tracing, and many reliability fixes.

changes.text: Keep revoked dashboard sessions signed out
changes.desc: Discord refresh and private dashboard streams now respect session revocation. Open support ticket streams also recheck the viewer's permissions.

changes.text: Recover PayPal payments and refunds after missed notifications
changes.desc: The gateway periodically checks unresolved orders and refunds. An older renewal can only extend the tier it paid for, and subscription expiry runs before the bot sends reminders. The unused recurring checkout route was removed.

changes.text: Share guest session limits across gateway instances
changes.desc: Guest limits survive restarts and deployments, and the gateway rejects oversized guest session requests.

changes.text: Keep dashboard requests responsive during streaming and shutdown
changes.desc: Live streams have their own connection pool. Guild lists and modlogs have upstream deadlines, and the gateway gives ordinary requests time to finish during a restart.

changes.text: Preserve paid subscription changes during billing races
changes.desc: Canceling renewal preserves time already paid for, and an older upgrade checkout cannot lower a newer tier. PayPal refunds stay pending until confirmed, and overlapping gateway instances coordinate renewal reminders.

changes.text: Protect dashboard session refresh during a takeover
changes.desc: A delayed refresh request cannot overwrite or remove another request's session rotation.

changes.text: Limit PayPal webhook request size
changes.desc: The gateway rejects oversized PayPal notifications before asking PayPal to verify them.

changes.text: Keep premium subscriptions consistent through billing retries
changes.desc: Paid renewals can no longer be overwritten by the expiry check or applied twice when PayPal retries a notification. Failed renewal reminders are eligible for another attempt.

changes.text: Report session lookup outages as temporary
changes.desc: The dashboard API reports a temporary service error when it cannot check a session. Session checks stop when the request is canceled.

changes.text: Chino can see pictures sent in DMs and mentions
changes.desc: A picture attached to a message sent to Chino in a DM or with an @mention now reaches the AI, within the usual picture limits and switches. When pictures are turned off, Chino still answers the text and says it could not see the picture.

changes.text: Songs start faster
changes.desc: A song that has been matched to an audio stream is remembered for up to six months, so playing it again starts right away without searching, even after a restart. The audio sources are kept warm in the background, so the first song after a quiet spell no longer times out. A stream that stops working is searched for again.

changes.text: Discord voice recording pipeline and owner management console
changes.desc: Added high-performance voice recording architecture with Discord gateway voice relaying, consent fencing, per-channel participant tracking, and an owner recorder management panel under /admin/recorder.

changes.text: Live speaking audio visualizer stream proxy
changes.desc: Real-time SSE proxying for recording session events, dynamically streaming audio energy and speaking indicators from voice recording agents directly to the dashboard.

changes.text: /record Discord panel for voice session control
changes.desc: Manage voice recording sessions directly in Discord with an interactive Components V2 panel to start or stop recording, view recent session archives, and configure channel consent and retention settings.

changes.text: Voice recordings dashboard and audio playback drawer
changes.desc: Browse recorded voice meetings in the server dashboard with live SSE speaking visualizers, filter sessions, and listen to master or individual speaker audio tracks in an audio playback drawer.

changes.text: AI meeting transcription with speaker separation
changes.desc: Transcribe recorded voice meetings on demand or automatically after inactivity, mapping speech segments back to exact Discord user names and timestamps with an interactive transcript viewer and JSON export.

changes.text: Recordings list shows sessions correctly
changes.desc: The recordings page now reads each meeting's status, speakers and length correctly, so live and past meetings show up as they should.

changes.text: Recordings page matches the rest of the dashboard
changes.desc: The recordings page, playback drawer and transcript window now use the same plain sections, badges and buttons as the other settings pages, and their text is readable in the dark theme.

changes.text: Meeting transcripts are paused
changes.desc: Recorded meetings are not transcribed for now, and no meeting audio is sent to an AI service. Transcripts will come back once their privacy rules are in place.

changes.text: Only the people in a meeting can open its recording
changes.desc: A recording can be opened by its host, server managers and the people who took part, unless they opted out. Recording also stays off if its settings are missing.

changes.text: Recordings respect "Include my voice"
changes.desc: A recording only captures the people in the voice channel (or the people the host picked), and never anyone who turned "Include my voice" off. If too many people are in the channel, the recording does not start instead of leaving some of them out.

changes.text: Music and recordings take turns
changes.desc: Chino has one voice connection per server, so music cannot start while a meeting is being recorded, and a recording cannot start while music plays. Each says why.

changes.text: Everyone in a recorded call is told, and can opt out
changes.desc: When a meeting is recorded, Chino posts a notice with an Opt out button in the voice channel's chat, and does not record if it cannot post it. Opting out deletes what was recorded of you in that meeting, people who join later are included, and the host can pick exactly who to record.

changes.text: Recordings keep their last seconds and end on time
changes.desc: Stopping a recording no longer throws away the audio that was still being saved, a meeting stops by itself at its time limit, and a meeting whose recorder fails ends with what was saved instead of blocking the server. Chino rejoins the call if its connection drops.

changes.text: Recordings play the whole meeting
changes.desc: Playback now plays every speaker side by side for the full meeting, with working Solo and Mute, speaker names, a download per speaker and marks where audio could not be saved. Before, only the first couple of seconds played.

changes.text: A message when your recording is ready
changes.desc: If you turned on "Message me when a recording is ready", Chino sends you a link once a meeting you were in has been saved. The link opens the recording on the dashboard after you sign in.

changes.text: Recording settings, names and buttons are correct
changes.desc: Your recording switches now show what you saved, people are listed by name, and you only see the buttons you can use. Managers can start a recording from the dashboard, and links from Discord open the right recording.

changes.text: The live speaking view is only for the people in the meeting
changes.desc: Who is speaking in a live recording can only be seen by the host, managers and the people being recorded, and only for meetings in that server.

changes.text: Recordings are deleted after 7 days
changes.desc: A recording, its playback files and everything about it are deleted 7 days after the meeting (an hour after a recording that failed to start). The privacy page now covers voice recordings.

changes.text: Corrected what voice recording does
changes.desc: Earlier notes for this version promised retention settings, transcripts with speaker names and transcription after inactivity. Recordings are kept a fixed 7 days, and transcripts are paused for now; everything else described in the newer recording entries is how it works.

changes.text: The recordings page updates live
changes.desc: The live speaking view now connects, and a running or just-stopped meeting updates by itself instead of staying on "Stopping" until you refresh.

changes.text: Recordings take much less storage
changes.desc: Each speaker's playback file now stores silence far more compactly, and the raw recorded pieces are removed once the playback files are ready, so a long meeting with little talking uses a fraction of the space it did.

changes.text: Merge speakers of a recording into one file
changes.desc: In a recording's playback, tick two or more speakers and merge them into a single file to download. You keep one merged file per meeting; merging again replaces it.

changes.text: Recording downloads save with a readable name
changes.desc: Download now saves a speaker's file as channel, date and name instead of opening it in a new tab, and gets a fresh link if the old one was about to expire.

changes.text: Chino shows one thinking sign, then answers
changes.desc: Asking Chino no longer shows "Chino is thinking" and then "Thinking…" before the answer. Slash commands show Discord's own thinking message, mentions and DMs show Chino typing, and the answer appears and fills in more smoothly.

changes.text: AI is off in a server until an admin turns it on
changes.desc: Servers that never saved an AI setting no longer have AI available to members. An admin turns it on in the dashboard under AI Settings. Servers that already saved their settings are not changed.

changes.text: Professional logging and request tracing
changes.desc: The bot, the API gateway and the dashboard now write logs in one format with the same fields, each line tagged with the feature it came from, and a trace id that follows a request across all three; traces can be sent to Grafana Tempo or any OpenTelemetry collector. Operators can raise the log level of one feature from the admin panel, repeated errors are capped instead of flooding the log, routine web-server chatter is gone, and a dashboard log line that printed a user's session was removed.

changes.text: Premium page and pricing docs follow plan changes
changes.desc: The Premium page and the Pricing and Limits docs page now show the current limits of every plan, including any changes made to a plan, instead of a fixed copy.

changes.text: Premium renews automatically, with fair upgrades and downgrades
changes.desc: Premium is now a monthly PayPal subscription. Upgrading charges only the difference for the rest of the month and switches at once; downgrading switches when the paid month ends; cancelling stops PayPal charging while you keep what you paid for. If a renewal payment fails, premium stays on for a few days while PayPal retries. People who paid month by month can turn on auto-renew without paying twice, and free trials (no PayPal needed) are ready but switched off for now.

changes.text: Billing control panel for the owner
changes.desc: The admin panel lists every subscriber with filters, shows each person's billing history, and lets the owner set prices and PayPal plans, give premium for a chosen period, end a gift or trial, cancel auto-renew and refund the last payment.

changes.text: Safer premium plan changes
changes.desc: The plan picker marks each tier as an upgrade or downgrade and no longer offers the plan you already have. Picking your current plan again undoes a scheduled downgrade, closing the PayPal window and trying again no longer locks you out, and renewals are checked with PayPal regularly so a missed notice never ends premium you paid for.

changes.text: Personal pricing on the landing page
changes.desc: The home page pricing shows current prices and free trials, and when you're signed in, your plan: when it renews or ends, days left and auto-renew. Your own tier can't be chosen again; the others say Upgrade or Downgrade.

changes.text: Show every limit no longer leaves blank rows
changes.desc: Expanding the pricing table on the home page now shows every limit instead of empty gaps.

summary: Fix interaction channel check on external servers and show ErrorId in console logs.

changes.text: Fix NullReferenceException in channel checks on external servers
changes.desc: Fall back to interaction channel ID so user-installed context commands (Explain, Ask Chino) run in servers where Chino is not a member.

changes.text: Show ErrorId in text console output template
changes.desc: Reference IDs (E-XXXXXXXX) are now visible in plain text stdout logs.

changes.text: Fix /user info silent failure in DMs and external servers
changes.desc: Prevent Discord 400 Bad Request error on empty banner URLs, add guild null-safety for non-guild callers, and await paginator dispatches.

changes.text: Dynamic Bot & Gateway version display on /status
changes.desc: Display live liveness, database readiness, and runtime version badges for both Discord Bot Core and API Gateway on the status dashboard without exposing internal metrics.

changes.text: Fix SynchronizationLockException in AgentRuntime.StartAsync
changes.desc: Replace thread-affine Monitor lock with async-compatible SemaphoreSlim in AgentRuntime to prevent exit failures when unwinding async state machines on ThreadPool transitions.

summary: Major release featuring the new Music Engine with Lavalink v4 crossfade, self-healing AI circuit breaker and live topology graph, native SkiaSharp Canvas Studio, unified Support Desk with YouTrack ticketing, 3-level RBAC, and the root workspace dashboard.

changes.text: Lavalink v4 Crossfade & Automix Integration
changes.desc: Full client integration of Lavalink v4 Crossfade API (/crossfade [enabled] [duration]) with seamless audio transitions, automatic track reservations, and audio analysis-backed automix windows.

changes.text: Centralized PostgreSQL Music Catalog & Spotify Integration
changes.desc: Universal database cache (music_tracks, music_lyrics) providing zero-latency song resolution before falling back to Spotify Web API, supporting albums, playlists, charts, and Spotify Canvas video loops.

changes.text: Synchronized Lyrics with Real-Time Sliding Window
changes.desc: Word- and syllable-level synchronized lyrics playback via /lyrics and player button with a dynamic 3,800-character window preventing Discord rate limits.

changes.text: /seek Command & Precise Position Scrubbing
changes.desc: Added /seek slash command and dashboard scrubber slider with flexible timestamp parsing (mm:ss, seconds, hh:mm:ss) and track duration validation.

changes.text: Standalone /music Web App & Personal Playlists
changes.desc: Full-screen Apple Music Tahoe-styled desktop and mobile web player with personal playlists CRUD (/api/v1/me/playlists), server playback, queue management, and delta SSE streaming.

changes.text: Dedicated Player Channel & Smart Lifecycle
changes.desc: One dedicated PlayerPanel per server with permission auto-detection, typed request support, in-memory activity ring buffer (500 events), voice co-presence checks, and idle auto-leave.

changes.text: Self-Healing AI Circuit Breaker & Failover Router
changes.desc: Per-model-alias circuit breaker with sliding window trip thresholds, 5-minute HalfOpen canary cooldown, and tier-bypass fallback cascading failing requests to healthy higher tiers ordered by lowest cost.

changes.text: Real-Time AI Topology Graph in Admin Console
changes.desc: Interactive draggable and zoomable canvas in the Next.js Ops Console fed by live SSE streams, showing in-flight turn counters, model health, electric pulse cables, and failover beams.

changes.text: Multi-Lingual AI Safety & Zero-Vulnerability PromptGuard
changes.desc: Leetspeak normalization, base64 instruction decoding, and prompt injection detection across 8 languages, with delimiter fencing (<<<USER_CHAT_CONTENT>>>) and system model identity scrubbing.

changes.text: 3-Phase AI Access & Anonymous Guest Sessions
changes.desc: Granular AI access control for Members, Signed-in non-members, and 2-hour HMAC-SHA256 anonymous guest sessions validated via Cloudflare Turnstile with zero message history persistence.

changes.text: Interactive Docs Assistant with Dashboard Element Guidance
changes.desc: AI documentation assistant that answers queries, validates links against live generated docs, and opens dashboard settings pages while highlighting up to 5 target UI elements sequentially.

changes.text: Native C# SkiaSharp 2D Rendering Engine
changes.desc: In-process SkiaSharp 2D rendering pipeline replacing external Node.js canvas service (saving 250MB+ RAM), supporting layered backgrounds, circular avatars, avatar decorations, text gradients, and progress bars.

changes.text: Web Canvas Studio & Custom Font Management
changes.desc: Interactive visual template editor (/dashboard/[id]/canvas) with real-time SkiaSharp previews, drag-and-drop layer controls, custom TrueType/OpenType font uploads (5MB cap), and 1-click slot assignments.

changes.text: Unified Multi-Desk Support Desk with AI Triage
changes.desc: Complete replacement of Ask Desk with multi-desk support system featuring automated AI ticket triage, custom desk instructions, moderator escalation to private Discord threads, and live transcript streaming.

changes.text: YouTrack Ticketing Integration & Discord DM Follow-ups
changes.desc: Seamless bug and suggestion intake to YouTrack CHI project via /report and web forms, with Turnstile anti-abuse protection and opt-in 2-way Discord DM reply routing.

changes.text: 3-Level RBAC (None / Read / Write) & Master-Detail Permissions
changes.desc: Granular role-based access control separating read-only inspection from settings mutation, backed by a unified module registry and Master-Detail management UI for roles and members.

changes.text: Honeypot Trap Channels & AutoMod Exemptions
changes.desc: Automated Honeypot rule engine that catches unauthorized trap channel messages and applies immediate timeouts/kicks/bans, alongside new AutoMod exempt roles, channels, and categories.

changes.text: Role Transition Triggers & Hardened Cron Scheduling
changes.desc: Added role_direction condition (role added or removed) to the visual automation builder, with UTC-aligned cron scheduling, natural language AI drafting, and error recovery.

changes.text: Scheduled Server Analytics Reports & /analytics Command
changes.desc: Automated periodic server analytics reports delivered to Discord channels with optional AI conversation summaries, alongside an interactive standalone /analytics slash command.

changes.text: Root Workspace Shell & Flat Design Skin
changes.desc: Unified dashboard workspace moved to root (/dashboard, /chat, /me/*, /together/*) with flat outline-free styling, floating palette, server tour, and live usage meters.

changes.text: Beta 3D Spatial Showcase (/beta)
changes.desc: Interactive WebGL Aura shader stage with 3D perspective card deck, pointer-reactive tilt physics, real WebM feature video loops, and a 16-module visual feature atlas.

changes.text: Personal Chino User-Installed App Commands
changes.desc: Right-click message actions (Explain, Ask Chino, Summarize, Translate) and personal onboarding that work in DMs and external servers without requiring bot guild membership.

changes.text: Chino Together Group Plans & Voice Handoff
changes.desc: Coordinate plans with interactive member availability time grids, ranked choice voting, RSVP attendance tracking, and automatic voice channel moves upon event start.

changes.text: Discord Components V2 Panels & 1-Click Web Links
changes.desc: Rebuilt Discord interactive panels (/configure, /mod, /music, /automate, /economy) with Components V2 layout, custom title emoji support, and direct 1-click web dashboard deep links.

changes.text: Bot Internationalization (BotLocalizer)
changes.desc: Resource bundle-backed localization system supporting English and Japanese across slash command responses, panel sections, and user onboarding.

changes.text: Structured JSON Logging for Grafana Loki
changes.desc: Serilog JSON output formatter emitting machine-readable logs with trace IDs, request IDs, ErrorId tags (E-XXXXXXXX), and live dynamic exception stack toggling in /admin console.

changes.text: PostgreSQL 18 Database Migration
changes.desc: Complete migration from legacy Apache Cassandra to PostgreSQL 18 with 75+ idempotent schema migrations, connection pooling, and transactional integrity.

changes.text: Clean Configuration Architecture
changes.desc: Eliminated legacy YAML configuration files in favor of strict separation: environment variables for secrets and network bindings, and database rows for tunable product settings.
